newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices follow U.S. down ahead of FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices follow U.S. down ahead of FOMC.

text.p: Danish bond prices opened lower on Tuesday, the first trading day after the Whitsun holiday, tracking U.S. treasuries down ahead of this afternoon's Federal Reserve meeting.
"The American market is apparently a little nervous before the FOMC meeting, and so is Denmark," a dealer said.
At 0705 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 was down 0.18 point from Friday's close, at 110.86, yielding 6.34 percent.
The forthcoming benchmark seven percent state bond due 2007 fell 0.48 point, to 103.42, yielding 6.53 percent.

The yield gap between the 2006 bond and the German bund narrowed one basis point to 54 bp and the 2007-bund gap also narrowed by basis point to 73 bp. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
